description: Wi-Fiスポット(中国・簡体語) [telecom] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 佐賀県. 在公布于本网站的设施信息中，包含部分使用日语的信息，这些信息的翻译工作一旦完成，我们将随时更新。. Coverage: 佐賀県. The portal files it under the publisher 佐賀県. Its tags are Wi-Fi, インフラ, 観光, 防災. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2019-10-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
